yt_title: Guess One Password a Day: You'd Need 572 Million Years
yt_description:
If you guessed once a day, how long until you got it? A birthday takes about a year, a 4-digit PIN about 27 years, and an 8-letter lowercase password about 572 million years.

Guess before you watch: how long for a 6-digit code? Comment your answer, then check it.

How it works: odds of 1 in N take about N tries on average, so at one try a day it takes N days.
